sections.content: How many people are "hire services managers and proprietors"?

15,930 people

were counted on the census as "hire services managers and proprietors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Managers and proprietors in hire services organise and direct the activities of businesses which hire goods and services, such as tools, heavy machinery and vehicles.

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "hire services managers and proprietors" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "hire services managers and proprietors", 14.6% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "hire services managers and proprietors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "hire services managers and proprietors" included:

  • print finishing and binding workers
  • mobile machine drivers and operatives (other)
  • window cleaners

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "hire services managers and proprietors" there were more men than women (75.9% compared with 24.1%).

This means "hire services managers and proprietors" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "other managers and proprietors".

Men made up 75.9% and women made up 24.1% of "hire services managers and proprietors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "hire services managers and proprietors" included:

  • brokers
  • chefs
  • production, factory and assembly supervisors

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "hire services managers and proprietors", 8.2% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (79.3% compared with 20.7%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (72.7%) than self-employed (27.3%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Buckinghamshire, this is in the same region of the South East.
